forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: Horizon 2026-06-16 passed without a publicly confirmed held negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals or envoys. Iran's 2026-06-01 suspension of talks remained in effect through the horizon date. No TIER1 source reported a convened session (direct or Oman/Qatar/Pakistan-mediated) before EOD June 16. Written message exchanges reported via Axios/Reuters do NOT satisfy resolution criteria. Resolution: NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. Judge ruling (2026-06-20): DA geographic ambiguity REJECTED. Reuters (June 19) reported IRGC drone and missile salvo targeting 'IDF positions in northern Israel.' Haaretz (June 19) confirmed Israeli air defenses intercepted the majority of the IRGC salvo with residual impacts on Israeli sovereign territory in the northern district. IRGC statement named Israeli targets explicitly, not Lebanese forward positions. Intel Crab OSINT-Telegram framing insufficient to rebut two TIER1 sources plus official IRGC statement. Source rule met: Reuters + Haaretz (two TIER1) confirm two-way exchange within the June 18-19 window. Combined with IDF strikes on Bandar Abbas (Reuters + Al Jazeera), the 48h bilateral exchange is confirmed. Resolving YES. p set to 0.95 as terminal resolution value.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: No material movement. MarineTraffic AIS data (Bloomberg, June 19) shows Hormuz transits at 3-7 vessels per day as of June 18-19, against pre-war baseline of approximately 94 per day. No demining commencement confirmed. P&I war-risk cover (Lloyd's of London) not reinstated. June 18-19 military exchange between Israel and Iran further deters insurer return and carrier resumption.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS tracker, specifically MarineTraffic or VesselFinder) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List); if PortWatch unavailable, MarineTraffic or VesselFinder AIS data cited by TIER1 qualifies as fallback.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use MarineTraffic or VesselFinder as fallback and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?

Judge ruling: Times of Israel is a TIER1 outlet; Ofir Katz as named coalition whip is a named primary source on the public record, satisfying the two-TIER1 standard for this UPDATE. Haredi draft-law side agreement remains unsigned, sustaining residual slippage risk. Raising 5pp to 0.50.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
